subject: Invitation to Company Networking Event
body: Dear [Recipient], You are cordially invited to our annual company networking event on Friday, June 25th. Join us for an evening of networking, cocktails, and live entertainment. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom of the Downtown Hotel starting at 6:00 PM. Please RSVP by June 18th to confirm your attendance. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name]
